verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document running the Elastic Observability stack self-managed in production, and it says nothing about deployment architecture or an upgrade path. The closest items do not qualify: running Elastic Agent in a container covers only the data-collection agent, and the 'open source platform' description is generic positioning with no deployment detail. Self-hosting is a fair axis for an observability platform, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path
